intent: Make the already authority-unbound SADHANA preparation operation power-loss safe. Every prepared manifest and the final NoEffect receipt must be written to a deterministic same-directory 0600 temporary file, fully written and fsynced, published with atomic no-replace semantics, and followed by directory fsync. A crash before publication must leave no authoritative final; a crash after linking must replay to the one exact authoritative inode; an existing mismatched final must remain unchanged and fail closed. This packet performs no provider, transport, deployment, service, VPS, public-route, or other external effect.

this_packet_provides: write-all plus file fsync before no-replace publication
directory fsync and nlink-aware stale-temporary replay
mismatched authoritative final rejection without overwrite
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: Prepared[Release, InputSet, Config, TaskSet]: NoEffect is authoritative only after exact-byte durable no-replace publication; a temporary or partial file has no promotion authority.

interface_mismatches: The initial preparation writer creates the final path before all bytes and durability barriers complete, so power loss can leave a partial authoritative-looking final that replay permanently rejects.
honest_blockers: This proves only crash-safe local NoEffect preparation; it does not prove root promotion, service activation, provider reachability, process liveness, deployment, or campaign completion.
A mismatched existing final is deliberately retained for forensic inspection and blocks replay until an authorized recovery procedure resolves it.
Generated DocOps count drift remains owned by the post-merge single-writer workflow and must not be hand-committed here.
Exact-head CI, independent review, merge authority, release sealing, and deployment proof remain separately required.
session_entry.rollback: Keep campaign dispatch stopped and revert this atomic-publication repair together with its tests and packet. Preserve any mismatched final or crash residue for forensic inspection; do not overwrite it during rollback.
